source.title: Three open problems and a conjecture

accepted.question_text: For an integer k ≥ 3, determine a closed form for the multiple series S_k = Σ_{n_1,...,n_k ≥ 1} (-1)^{n_1+...+n_k} H_{n_1+...+n_k}/(n_1 n_2 ··· n_k), where H_m = Σ_{j=1}^m 1/j is the m-th harmonic number.

evidence.quote: 3.134. Let k 3 be an integer. Calculate Sk D X1 n1;:::;nkD1 .1/n1Cn2C···Cnk Hn1Cn2C···Cnk /(n1n2 · · · nk).
In this paper, we solve these problems and prove the conjecture is true.
We record the solution of this problem in the next theorem.

accepted.question_text: For an integer k ≥ 2, evaluate in closed form the multiple series T_k = Σ_{n_1,...,n_k ≥ 1} (-1)^{n_1+...+n_k} H_{n_1}H_{n_2}···H_{n_k}/(n_1 n_2 ··· n_k (n_1+n_2+...+n_k)), where H_m = Σ_{j=1}^m 1/j is the m-th harmonic number.

evidence.quote: 3.135. Let k 2 be an integer. Evaluate, in closed form, the multiple series Tk D X1 n1;···;nkD1 .1/n1Cn2C···Cnk Hn1Hn2 · · · Hnk /(n1n2 · · · nk.n1 C n2 C · · · C nk/).
We give only a partial result to this problem which we record in the next theorem.

Remark 1.3. It is worth mentioning that the problem cannot be solved in the sense that in general, alternating sums appear which are (conjecturally) not expressible as polynomials in ζ(s), ln 2 and Li_s(1/2).

accepted.question_text: For an integer k ≥ 3, determine a closed form for the multiple alternating Hardy series A_k = Σ_{n_1,...,n_k ≥ 1} (-1)^{n_1+...+n_k} (H_{n_1+...+n_k} - ln(n_1+n_2+...+n_k) - γ), where H_m = Σ_{j=1}^m 1/j and γ is Euler's constant.

accepted.question_text: For an integer k ≥ 4, decide whether the multiple factorial series Σ_{n_1,...,n_k ≥ 1} n_1 n_2 ··· n_k/(n_1+n_2+...+n_k)! is always a rational multiple of e; equivalently, determine whether there exists a rational number a_k such that Σ_{n_1,...,n_k ≥ 1} n_1 n_2 ··· n_k/(n_1+n_2+...+n_k)! = a_k e.

evidence.quote: 3.137. Does the sum equal a rational multiple of e? Let k 4 be an integer. Calculate the sum X1 n1;···;nkD1 n1n2 · · · nk /(n1 C n2 C · · · C nk)!.
Conjecture. It is reasonable to conjecture that ... = a_k e, where a_k is a rational number.
In the next theorem we solve this problem and show the conjecture holds true.

accepted.question_text: Investigate arithmetic or structural properties of the rational sequence (a_k)_{k∈N} defined by a_k = Σ_{i=0}^{k-1} binom(k-1, i)/(k+i)! for k ≥ 1, equivalently by Σ_{n_1,...,n_k ≥ 1} n_1 n_2 ··· n_k/(n_1+n_2+...+n_k)! = a_k e.

evidence.quote: If the conjecture holds true, an open problem would be to study the properties of the sequence (a_k)_{k∈N}.
